title: Amazon loses 40 Leo satellites after ULA's Vulcan rocket fails 10 minutes into flight, marking the first mission failure for the Boeing-Lockheed joint venture (Joey Roulette/Reuters)
summary: Joey Roulette / Reuters: Amazon loses 40 Leo satellites after ULA's Vulcan rocket fails 10 minutes into flight, marking the first mission failure for the Boeing-Lockheed joint venture — A Vulcan rocket owned by United Launch Alliance, the joint venture of Boeing (BA.N) and Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) …
